commitRole: release: v0.3.0 (main branch HEAD at vendoring time)

verified.method: git clone, git rev-parse HEAD, then copy of the working tree minus .git and .github

snapshotDigestAlgorithm: sha256 over each file, concatenated as <relative posix path>\0<sha256-of-file or 'link:<target>'>\0, paths sorted
adaptation: The vendored tree is the unmodified upstream snapshot, kept for provenance and future diffs. It is V1 plugin code and is NOT loaded at runtime. The V2 implementation in src/ reuses the session layer (marker protocol, mutex, reader, shell quoting, connection manager) with two changes: Bun process/file APIs replaced by node:child_process and node:fs, and connections keyed by root session so SSH subagents share their parent's connection. See ../../CONTEXT.md.
